2609.00718.title: A Closed-Loop Evaluation of Capability Loss and Recovery in Compressed Driving Policies
2609.00718.paper_summary: Many automobile and mobility companies deploy learned driving policies on embedded computers with limited memory and power. Pruning, knowledge distillation, and quantization are the standard methods to reduce the size and the inference cost of these policies. However, these methods are commonly assessed by aggregate numerical scores, and such scores may not reflect the ability of the policy to drive safely when interacting with other road users. In this study, we propose a stage-wise closed-loop evaluation approach to follow a driving policy through a compression pipeline. We formulate the driving task as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) and train a belief-state policy with proximal policy optimization (PPO) in Gym-Duckietown. We then extract the actor, compress it one stage at a time, and evaluate it on five driving curricula. We show that structured pruning is the stage at which the driving capability is first lost. Meanwhile, distillation improves the pruned actor, but the improvement is limited by its rehearsal data. Integer quantization of the improved actor loses some of the curricula that require the vehicle to stop and then resume. Interestingly, the same procedure on the unpruned actor preserves all five curricula. Our study thus provides an empirical analysis aiming to answer the currently active discussions on how to accept a compressed driving policy, so as to achieve a safe and statistically reliable deployment of automated driving functions.
2609.00718.paper_summary_zh: 許多汽車和移動公司在內存和功率有限的嵌入式計算機上部署學習到的駕駛策略。剪枝、知識蒸餾和量化是減少這些策略大小和推理成本的標準方法。然而，這些方法通常是通過總體數值評分來評估的，而這些評分可能無法反映策略在與其他道路使用者互動時安全駕駛的能力。在本研究中，我們提出了一種階段性閉環評估方法，以跟踪駕駛策略通過壓縮管道的過程。我們將駕駛任務表述為部分可觀察的馬爾可夫決策過程（POMDP），並在Gym-Duckietown中使用近端策略優化（PPO）訓練信念狀態策略。然後，我們逐階段提取演員，進行壓縮，並在五個駕駛課程上進行評估。我們顯示結構化剪枝是駕駛能力首次喪失的階段。與此同時，蒸餾改善了剪枝後的演員，但改進受到其重演數據的限制。改進後演員的整數量化失去了某些需要車輛停下來然後重新啟動的課程。有趣的是，對未剪枝演員進行相同的程序可以保留所有五個課程。因此，我們的研究提供了一個實證分析，旨在回答當前活躍的討論，即如何接受壓縮的駕駛策略，以實現自動駕駛功能的安全和統計可靠的部署。
